status: STUB - no approval manifest exists; none may be generated by Grok or by code
description: Separate from the frozen baseline. Written only after a qualified teacher approves links; release gates read it, never write it.

required_fields.reference_version: string; must match a frozen baseline
required_fields.baseline_manifest_sha256: sha256 of the frozen baseline manifest it approves against
required_fields.approved_links: list of {link_id, official_source_url, verbatim_passage, page, reviewer, review_date, decision}
required_fields.second_reviews: list of {link_id, reviewer, review_date, decision} for needs_second_review=YES

historical_records_rule: Every generated test/student record stores reference_version + curriculum_edition + exam_session + software_version from its manifest and is never re-labelled.
